title: Relax synthetic metric guard + regenerate synthetic bronze so the 6 PDF-mandated metrics populate across all 12 synthetic cells
description: DEF-001 remediation. Two-layer root cause: (1) data/bronze/synthetic parquet predated T-002 (no __truth_id); (2) run_experiment.py:177 guard gated the 6 metrics behind a non-empty truth DataFrame so the NoiseTruth sidecar never reached the sidecar-only scorers. Fix: relax the guard to accept EITHER truth_df (with __truth_id) OR a NoiseTruth sidecar carrying original_ids; regenerate bronze with post-T-002 synthetic.py; rerun matrix with --truth passing the clean synthetic_truth parquet so position_rmse_m has a full-coverage truth frame (the advisor confirmed NoiseTruth.original_coords is sparse jumped-only and is NOT a valid rmse fallback).

commands_run.notes: regen bronze with __truth_id; 2 hours matches prior layout hour=0+hour=1

commands_run.cmd: python etl4/bench/run_matrix.py --bronze data/bronze/synthetic --truth etl4/data/reference/synthetic_truth/2026-01-01.parquet --source synthetic --profiles N0 N1 N2 N3 --methods time_gap kinematic kinematic_smoothing --workers 1

docker exec etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -c "SELECT method, noise, rmse_m, seg_f1, seg_precision, seg_recall, coverage_ratio, boundary_err_s FROM fact_experiment_result WHERE source='synthetic' ORDER BY noise, method;"
docker exec etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_pareto_frontier;"

DEF-001.fix_summary: Guard at run_experiment.py:177 now enters the metric block when EITHER truth_df carries __truth_id OR NoiseTruth.original_ids is populated. position_rmse_m still receives truth_df (NoiseTruth.original_coords is jumped-only and would skew RMSE). Bronze regenerated with __truth_id. Matrix rerun with --truth populates all 12 cells.
DEF-001.verification_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_experiment_result WHERE source='synthetic' AND (rmse_m IS NULL OR seg_f1 IS NULL OR seg_precision IS NULL OR seg_recall IS NULL OR coverage_ratio IS NULL OR boundary_err_s IS NULL)

residual_risks: N0's coverage denominator is the bronze ids (not the pre-add_noise 14,400 ids), so N0 coverage 0.969 can sit below N1's 0.982. Expected given the bronze -> silver drop; not a defect for this ticket.

run_matrix.py requires --truth to be passed explicitly for the synthetic path; absent it, position_rmse_m still returns None (the other 5 metrics still populate via the NoiseTruth sidecar). A durable fix would mirror run_experiment.py:223's truth-from-bronze fallback inside run_matrix.py. Flagged for data-engineer / future ticket; out of scope here per the 'files you may touch' list.
kinematic_smoothing RMSE for N2/N3 renders as 1.3M+ meters (smoother divergence under heavy shuffling). Not a WI-1 scope defect; pre-existing filter behavior under 10% out-of-order noise.
